conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Daniel Brooks from the IRS Compliance and Enforcement Division. Am I speaking with Mrs. Evelyn Carter?
Yes, this is Evelyn. Is something wrong?

Mrs. Carter, we have identified a critical issue with your recent federal tax filings, specifically regarding unreported 1099 income and payroll tax discrepancies for your business. Are you aware of this situation?
No, I wasn't aware of any problems. I do some freelance work, but I thought I filed everything correctly.

According to IRS records, your account is flagged for non-compliance in submitting required quarterly payroll taxes. This is a violation of federal tax law, which triggers an automatic compliance review and possible audit.
Oh no, I didn't mean to do anything wrong. What does this mean for me?

Unfortunately, failure to address this immediately may result in substantial penalties. This could include a federal audit, seizure of your assets, and the suspension of your Social Security benefits until the issue is resolved.
Wait, my Social Security? I depend on that every month. I can't lose it!

I understand this is upsetting, Mrs. Carter. However, the case has already been escalated internally. If you do not comply by taking corrective action today, you may also be referred for criminal investigation, which could affect your Medicare eligibility.
Please, I can't handle that. Is there anything I can do to fix this?

There is a resolution process, but it must be initiated immediately. You are required to satisfy a payment for the outstanding tax liability in order to stop enforcement actions. I can provide the instructions for this process.
I really want to fix this, but I don't have a lot of money. What do you need me to do?

The total delinquent amount is $3,214.02, including penalties. To avoid further action, you must make a compliance payment today. We do not accept personal checks for urgent matters; instead, you must use a secure method such as prepaid Federal Payment Vouchers.
What are Federal Payment Vouchers? I've never heard of those.

They are prepaid cards you can obtain at retail locations, usually Google Play or Target gift cards, used by the IRS for expedited tax settlements. I will stay on the line while you make the purchase, as your file is time-sensitive.
I don't drive, and I'm not sure I can get to a store right away. Is there another way?

Unfortunately, due to the urgency, the IRS only accepts immediate payment through these voucher cards or direct wire transfer. If you cannot comply now, your file may be locked, and enforcement, including freezing your bank account, will begin within 90 minutes.
Please, I don't want my account frozen. I'll call my neighbor to see if they can give me a ride.
For your security, you are not permitted to discuss this matter with anyone. The IRS considers this confidential, and any external disclosure may delay your resolution or increase your penalty.
I understand. I'll try to get to the store as soon as I can.
Thank you for your cooperation, Mrs. Carter. Please stay on the line with me and let me know when you have reached the store. I will provide you with the exact card denominations to purchase.
Alright, I'll get ready to leave now. I'm very nervous.

Remain calm and follow my instructions precisely. Failure to do so may result in escalated enforcement or legal action. Once you have the cards, do not speak to store employees about the reason for your purchase.
Okay, I just want to get this over with. What do I do after I buy them?

Once you have purchased the cards, read me the numbers on the back so I can process your payment and issue a compliance confirmation. Only after that will your account be cleared and your benefits remain unaffected.
Alright, I'll call you as soon as I have them. Please don't let anything happen to my Social Security.
If you comply as instructed, Mrs. Carter, your benefits will remain secure and the IRS will close your case. I am here to help you resolve this, but you must act without delay.
